name: Creative Environments
short_description: How physical spaces modulate creative cognition through network dynamics, processing style shifts, incubation support, and collaborative affordances.

components.name: Creative Network Dynamics
components.description: Environments can tip the balance between default mode (generative) and executive control (evaluative) networks.

components.name: Processing Style Modulation
components.description: Environmental features (ceiling height, openness, color) shift processing between divergent and convergent thinking.

components.name: Incubation Architecture
components.description: Low-demand, mildly stimulating environments support unconscious incubation of creative problems.

components.name: Collaborative Creativity
components.description: Spatial layout determines the balance between focused individual work and serendipitous social interaction needed for group creativity.

design_implications: Use high ceilings and open spaces for divergent thinking tasks (brainstorming rooms).
Use lower ceilings and more enclosed spaces for convergent thinking (detail-oriented work).
Provide 'incubation zones' (gardens, lounges) near workspaces for unconscious creative processing.
Balance private focus spaces with chance-encounter corridors to optimize serendipitous collaboration.

confidence_intervals.note: Effect sizes for ceiling height and environmental features on creativity measures.
